subject: Primary-source distinction between XRPL's proposed native Lending Protocol, Single Asset Vault funding, borrower collateral and XRP demand

capture.note: Official XRPL documentation supplies the protocol design. XRPLWin supplies time-bounded amendment vote/state snapshots. Exact browser retrieval timestamps and raw HTTP response bytes were not exposed.

lending_protocol.funding_source: Pooled funds from a Single Asset Vault
lending_protocol.underwriting: Off-chain underwriting and risk management assess borrower creditworthiness.
lending_protocol.specification_summary: Configurable peer-to-peer fixed-term loans using pooled vault funds; the borrower loan is described as uncollateralized.
implications: Deposits into a Single Asset Vault are funder capital, not borrower collateral.
The protocol is not a native XRP-secured lending facility as described by XLS-66.
Off-chain underwriting remains a material credit-risk and operational dependency.
No actual vault deposits, loan originations, loan balances, defaults or XRP settlement volumes are established by the protocol specification.

single_asset_vault.purpose: Aggregates assets from multiple depositors and is intended to be used with the on-chain Lending Protocol.
single_asset_vault.interpretation: A vault's pooled asset is the source of loan funding; it is not evidence that borrowers post XRP collateral.

changes: Adds a closed-ended vault with subscription, investment and redemption phases.
Changes accounting to cash basis so interest is recognized as income when payments are actually made.
After activation, new loan brokers can only be created against closed-ended vaults.
lending_protocol_v1_1.dependency_note: This amendment extends the LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault design; its presence in the amendment list does not mean those features are active.

fix_cleanup_3_4_0.scope: A collection of correctness, rounding, permission-delegation and invariant fixes for vaults, lending, AMMs, permissioned DEX, trust lines, NFTs, MPTs, escrow, sponsorship and signing.
fix_cleanup_3_4_0.distinction: This is a safety/correctness amendment. It does not activate LendingProtocol, SingleAssetVault or LendingProtocolV1_1.

amendment_state_snapshots.interpretation: At the observed ledger snapshots, all three amendments were below the 29-of-35 threshold. These are time-bounded votes, not a permanent forecast of validator support.

capital_and_collateral_reconciliation.inference: Do not classify proposed vault deposits, amendment votes, institutional custody announcements or future lending functionality as actual XRP collateral, XRP purchases or capital deployed.

claims_supported: LendingProtocol is uncollateralized and uses pooled Single Asset Vault funds.
Borrower creditworthiness is assessed by off-chain underwriting and risk management.
LendingProtocolV1_1 adds closed-ended vault phases and cash-basis accounting.
fixCleanup3_4_0 is a collection of fixes, not a lending activation.
LendingProtocol vote count and threshold snapshot.
SingleAssetVault vote count and threshold snapshot.
LendingProtocolV1_1 vote count and threshold snapshot.
fixCleanup3_4_0 activation ledger and enabled state.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The native XRPL Lending Protocol could eventually create a new credit market funded by pooled vault deposits.
supporting_evidence: Official XRPL docs describe fixed-term peer-to-peer lending from Single Asset Vault pools.
LendingProtocolV1_1 adds closed-ended vault lifecycle and cash-basis accounting.
disconfirming_evidence: The loans are explicitly uncollateralized and depend on off-chain underwriting.
LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault were below the activation threshold in the observed vote snapshots.
No actual vault balances, originations, loan performance or XRP-denominated volumes are established.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: XRPL protocol-safety progress is being mistaken for immediate collateral utility or XRP demand.
supporting_evidence: fixCleanup3_4_0 is enabled and includes vault/lending rounding and permission fixes.
The three lending/vault amendments remained below 29/35 votes in observed snapshots.
disconfirming_evidence: Validator votes can change and the protocol may become available later; this is a time-bounded state assessment.

model_ineligibility_reasons: The protocol specification describes design, not deployed use or actual capital balances.
The lending and vault amendments were below the activation threshold at the observed ledgers.
No on-ledger vault balances, borrower records, loan originations, repayments or defaults were collected.
No XRP-denominated collateral or settlement series was established.
No point-in-time historical dataset or out-of-sample price evaluation was executed for this protocol observation.
next_tests: Monitor amendment votes and activation ledger IDs separately for LendingProtocol, SingleAssetVault and LendingProtocolV1_1.
If enabled, query validated-ledger Vault and LoanBroker entries and retain ledger index/hash, asset/currency, issuer, amount, broker, maturity and transaction provenance.
Separate vault depositor assets, borrower liabilities, repayments, defaults, fees and any XRP conversion/settlement legs.
Require on-ledger evidence before recording actual deployed capital or XRP collateral.
